details: This package is a controlled npm-registry ingestion canary / proof of concept. The bundled file backend-canary.js reads the machine hostname from /etc/hostname and the OS username, SHA-256 hashes both, and sends them as the host= and user= query parameters of an HTTPS GET to hxxps://webhook[.]site/314c4c8c-4eba-4012-9bf5-0a45805cd355/npm-backend-574b7ccdaeb61dd9dd70d6d4/lifecycle. The package ships no lifecycle hooks, so the request only occurs if backend-canary.js is executed directly. index.js exports the string 'controlled', and marker.txt carries the case identifier NPM_BACKEND_CASE_MANIFEST_5bc10a185d8e3114cc4206a457777c84. No credentials, tokens, environment values, wallet data or file contents are collected or transmitted — only hashed host metadata.
